entities.name: Force
entities.definition: Force is the derived physical quantity of interaction: an influence capable of changing the state of motion of a body, Newton second law net force equals rate of change of momentum (for constant mass F = m a). SI derived unit the newton, N = kg m s-2. Reference: Halliday, Resnick, Walker 12th ed. Ch 5; Newton, Principia (1687), Lex II.

provenance.source: Halliday, Resnick, Walker, Fundamentals of Physics 12th ed., Ch 5: net force ΣF = m a; Principia (1687), Lex II: mutationem motus proportionalem esse vi motrici impressae.

entities.name: Length
entities.definition: Length is the fundamental physical quantity of spatial extent — the measure of one-dimensional distance between points. It is one of the seven base quantities of the SI (dimension L); its SI base unit is the metre (m). Agreed per BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019), base quantities table.

provenance.source: BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019): among the seven SI base quantities, length with base unit metre; metre defined by fixed numerical value of c in vacuum (2.3.1).

entities.name: Mass
entities.definition: Mass is the fundamental physical quantity measuring inertia and amount of substance of a body. It is one of the seven base quantities of the SI (dimension M); its SI base unit is the kilogram (kg), defined by taking the fixed numerical exact value of the Planck constant h = 6.62607015e-34 J s. Agreed per BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019).

provenance.source: BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019): mass among the seven SI base quantities; kilogram defined by fixed h = 6.62607015e-34 kg m2 s-1 (2.3.1).

entities.name: Time
entities.definition: Time is the fundamental physical quantity of duration and temporal sequence. It is one of the seven base quantities of the SI (dimension T); its SI base unit is the second (s), defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the caesium-133 hyperfine transition frequency ΔνCs = 9,192,631,770 Hz. Agreed per BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019).

provenance.source: BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed. (2019): time among the seven SI base quantities; second defined by fixed ΔνCs = 9,192,631,770 Hz (2.3.1).

evidence.locator: Ch 5, Newton's second law, net force = mass x acceleration
evidence.description: Newton's second law quantifies force via mass.
Principia Lex II ties impressed force to change of motion (quantity of matter).
